module: Distance call configuration of the English styles: link words depending on the gap between two notes, spoken units, rounding rules and maximum spoken distance. Read by textCompositor (roundDistance, distanceToString, getDistanceCallShorthand...).
notes: Links: gap < 5 m = no word (text nil), < 20 m = 'into', < 40 m = 'and'; beyond that, the distance is spoken in digits.
Units: base 'm', large 'km', decimal point word 'point'.
Rounding: 10 m step below 100 m, 50 m step from 100 m to 1000 m, beyond 1000 m value in km with a 250 m step. Max distance: 2000 m.
The module returns the table directly (no M).

links.desc: Ordered links {threshold, text} with strictly increasing thresholds (5, 20, 40 m).
